'''''Introducing Incom's T-65 "X-Wing" Space Superiority Fighter''''' was a printed advertisement for the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] that was issued in copies of the ''[[Galactic Defense Review]]'' publication in circulation prior to Incom being [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalized]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The advertisement had blueprints of the starfighter in the background as well as supplying detailed information on the technical innovations of the starfighter, including improved targeting computers, engines, and life support systems.<ref name="TRG1" />
